subject.title: Crons ejecutaron mensajes de WhatsApp a la 1 AM fuera de horario y no se podían detener

question: Should this issue be scoped to the existing schedule-activation replay PR only, or should it also require a first-class emergency stop/delete cancellation surface before closure?
rationale: Source inspection shows the replay subset is actively addressed by an open PR, while the kill-switch/delete semantics are product-facing behavior that could affect gateway, cron, and channel ownership boundaries.

options.title: Track Both Behaviors Here
options.body: Keep this issue open until restart catch-up is bounded and a maintainer-approved emergency stop/delete behavior is either implemented or split into a canonical follow-up.

options.title: Split Emergency Stop
options.body: Use this issue for restart catch-up only and open or designate a separate canonical issue for outbound emergency stop and in-flight cron cancellation semantics.

options.title: Replay-Only Closure After Merge
options.body: Close this issue once the schedule-activation PR lands, accepting that emergency stop/delete behavior will not be required by this report.

recommendation.title: Track Both Behaviors Here
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until restart catch-up is bounded and a maintainer-approved emergency stop/delete behavior is either implemented or split into a canonical follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the currently open fix candidate for the restart replay subset, which is the most concrete implementation path connected to this issue.
